quicknav.config.title: Quick Nav Settings
quicknav.config.quickNav.button.chooseSk: Select a SkyBlock icon or item to fill this button with.
quicknav.config.quickNav.button.item.com:
A string of item components enclosed in square brackets, which is the same format as the /give command.

Example: [minecraft:enchantment_glint_override=true]
Tooltip shown when hovering your mouse over the button.

You can use text json format.
Putting nothing will make the tooltip not render.
quicknav.config.quickNav.dungeonWarpMode:
Choose how warp commands are protected while inside a dungeon.

Auto: every /warp button requires a double-click to activate.
Manual: only the buttons you select require a double-click.
Disabled: behaviour is identical inside and outside dungeons.
Adds 14 customizable inventory buttons that can be styled and run a command when clicked.
quicknav.config.quickNav.manualSelection: Select which buttons require a double-click while inside a dungeon. Only active in Manual mode.
quicknav.config.quickNav.warpButtonsRedI: When dungeon warp protection is active, also render the protected buttons with a red tint while inside a dungeon to visually warn you.
